focus: 问入学、接送、问老师情况
sentences: I want to enroll my son in this school.
我想让我儿子报名上这所学校。
What documents do I need to apply?
I pick him up at school every afternoon.
我每天下午去学校接他。
Can I ask about how my kid is doing?
我想问问孩子的情况，可以吗？
Who is his form teacher, please?
请问他的班主任是哪位老师？
Does he behave well in class?
Is there a school bus on my street?
我们这条街有校车经过吗？
